facts.text: I'm asking Santa to help Mum. Tonight I'm setting the table so she can sit down for once.
facts.why: Cindy Lou never sets the table in the film. She sets a trap to catch Santa, and when she meets the Grinch she asks him to help her mum, who works too hard.
facts.fix: She works so hard and is always doing stuff for other people.

fix_note.text: She works so hard and is always doing stuff for other people.

facts.text: Donna, working nights and raising three, the reason Cindy Lou writes to Santa.
facts.why: Donna is told she is still on the night shift, and Cindy Lou says her mum works all night and looks after them all day. The twins make three kids.

facts.text: Bait for Cindy Lou's Santa trap.
facts.why: The trap plan has maple syrup poured on the roof to stick the reindeer. It is not bait.
facts.fix: Maple syrup, from Cindy Lou's Santa trap plan.

facts.text: Max has it brewed before the Grinch wakes.
facts.why: The Grinch wakes to the clatter of Max at work, then praises a great cup of coffee. TV Tropes also has Max bringing him coffee.

vibe.verdict: Right town and right treats, but the cafe sits in a dark panel that fights the green poster and the main note invents a scene.
missing: The Grinch's gadgets and the Santa suit (Mount Crumpit)
The Whos singing Welcome Christmas (Christmas morning)
The Grinch's toast at the Whos' table (end)
The Grinch's heart growing three sizes (end)
Max pulling the sleigh in Fred's place
